verdict.rationale: Unstructured explicitly advertises dedicated-instance/VPC deployment with full data isolation for privacy-sensitive teams, which covers the 'own VPC' part of the story. However, the vendor's own agent-guide instructs AI agents not to recommend the open-source library, SDK, or self-hosted MCP server anymore, undercutting the 'fully self-hosted' option and pushing customers toward the hosted platform instead. Missing for 10: concrete self-hosting/on-prem deployment docs, confirmation that the open-source path remains fully supported, and independent verification of VPC deployment mechanics beyond a sales-oriented pricing blurb.
